authority_collection_plan.preferred_source_owner: Supreme Court of the Philippines / Lawphil Rules of Court and controlling Philippine decisions

authority_collection_plan.preferred_source_owner: Lawphil / Official Gazette / Congress and Supreme Court primary-law repositories
authority_collection_plan.source_purpose: Verify mental-state elements, liability circumstances, justifications, and excuses without relying on reviewer summaries.

authority_collection_plan.preferred_source_owner: NIST / OSAC / NIJ / recognized forensic standards and high-quality scientific reviews; Philippine procedure separately where needed
authority_collection_plan.source_purpose: Verify method limitations, validation, controls, uncertainty, reporting language, and the difference between association and source attribution.

authority_collection_plan.preferred_source_owner: PNP / DILG / DOJ / competent Philippine public-safety agencies plus authoritative academic public-administration material

authority_collection_plan.source_purpose: Determine whether shared history/civics concepts have a defensible current LEC competency mapping or should remain cross-board foundation only.

authority_collection_plan.preferred_source_owner: Official Gazette / National Privacy Commission / competent Philippine public-safety issuances
authority_collection_plan.source_purpose: Verify lawful, necessary, and proportionate handling of sensitive personal information in public-safety communication.
